summary: MannKind filed a routine Form 8-K reporting an automatic shelf takedown: a Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement dated August 21, 2026 to its Form S-3 (No. 333-285286) covering resale of up to 12,853,470 common shares by selling stockholders — 10,440,838 outstanding shares plus up to 2,412,632 warrant shares underlying pre-funded warrants issued under a July 23, 2026 securities purchase agreement. Cooley LLP's legality opinion and consent are attached. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation or advisor was disclosed; no special-situation event is present, just ordinary registration mechanics, so the risk-arb angle is limited to resale overhang and warrant exercise.
